WITH rating_avgs AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
    AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rating
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS overall_mean
  FROM rating_avgs
)
SELECT r.rating,
       r.avg_rate_per_day,
       r.avg_rate_per_day - o.overall_mean AS above_overall_mean
FROM rating_avgs AS r
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE o.overall_mean IS NOT NULL
  AND r.avg_rate_per_day > o.overall_mean;

assumptions.assumption: The simple mean gives each rating with a non-NULL average equal weight, regardless of how many qualifying films it contains.
